usedFor: Shopify holds checkouts, and YCloud emails customers when “Abandoned Checkout” runs “Send an Email”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Send an Email” in YCloud
bestTemplate.why: The shopper left an email at checkout, so a reminder can go to the right person.

watchOut: An email to a customer waits in Needs you for approval, and “Abandoned Checkout” is polling.
